### Short Answer
An individual must file the annual income tax return (Form 1701) on or before April 15 of the following year, covering the income earned in the previous calendar year.

### Interpretation

### Practical Meaning
Taxpayers should ensure that they prepare and submit their income tax returns by the April 15 deadline to avoid penalties for late filing. It is advisable to keep accurate records of income and expenses throughout the year to facilitate the timely and accurate completion of the return.
